versions.changelog:
- Clarified and shortened the skill description for greater emphasis on the four coding principles and their common pitfalls.
- No changes to the rules or principles themselves; content remains focused on Andrej Karpathy’s coding observations.
- Improved readability and focus in the introductory section.

- Initial release of the Karpathy Coding Rules skill (v1.0.0).
- Provides concise coding principles inspired by Andrej Karpathy for script writing, automation, and bugfixing.
- Focuses on four core rules: clarify assumptions, prioritize simplicity, make precise changes, and define/verify success criteria.
- Includes a practical checklist for self-review before submitting code.
- Guidance applicable to Python, PowerShell, and code-assistant scenarios.
